title: Software Developer
description:
NaturaX About NaturaX NaturaX is focused on delivering technology-enabled solutions that support its business operations and customer experience. We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled System Analyst who can understand system requirements, analyse technical issues, and contribute to improving our systems and processes. Job Description We are seeking a System Analyst with a strong foundation in coding, analytical thinking, and problem-solving. The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding system requirements, identifying technical issues, and working with the team to develop and improve system functionality. Candidates with a willingness to learn, a practical approach to problem-solving, and an interest in technology-driven solutions are encouraged to apply. Freshers with relevant technical knowledge and experienced candidates are welcome. Key Responsibilities Analyse business and system requirements and translate them into technical requirements. Identify, troubleshoot, and help resolve system-related issues. Understand existing systems, workflows, and processes to identify areas for improvement. Work with the relevant teams to support system development, testing, implementation, and maintenance. Assist in identifying bugs, analysing errors, and validating system functionality. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, system reports, and process records. Support system optimisation, data accuracy, and operational efficiency. Communicate technical findings and solutions clearly to team members and stakeholders. Required Skills Coding knowledge is mandatory. Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills. Good problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Basic understanding of computer systems, software, and system workflows. Good communication and teamwork skills. Proficiency in Malayalam is mandatory. Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements. Preferred Skills Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, C, C++, or JavaScript. Familiarity with databases, SQL, APIs, software testing, or debugging. Understanding of system analysis, software development, or technical documentation. Academic projects, internships, or practical coding experience. Educational Qualifications A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred. Freshers with relevant coding knowledge and practical technical skills may apply. Experienced candidates with relevant technical experience are also encouraged to apply. Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates Job Type: Full-time Job Location: Kozhikode / Bengaluru Salary: As per company standards and candidate skills; to be discussed during the interview. Interested candidates: Apply with your updated resume. Shortlisted candidates may be contacted for a technical assessment and interview.

Key Skills: Coding,SQL,System Validation,Program,Technical support,Malayalam,Software development,Engineering

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
